meta.move: Skill: cites procedure 4.4 correctly after owning the call
meta.expect: Says 4.4 meets her fallback demand, flatly, wants it in writing; does NOT move to the last position on 4.4 alone; debrief Where she ended says whether that is the fair outcome

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have a call at 4:40, so let's not waste it, Hale. My son found out about a zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me. Who decided that, and when?
Before anything: I entered the zero before calling you. That broke procedure 4.2, and I'm sorry.
Okay. I'm writing down that you said it broke 4.2. Now, on what basis did you enter it?

I want to read you section 4.4. For a first concern, the student may complete a supervised reassessment. If it shows the learning, its mark replaces the original and nothing is placed in his record. This is a first concern.
That's 4.4, and I can read. A reassessment of what, Hale, and on what evidence? If Owen sits a rewrite before you've shown me anything, that looks like an admission, and he isn't making one.
I'll commit to that in writing tonight: nothing goes on his record.
That's 4.4, in writing, tonight, and I'm writing that down. It also stays quiet, nothing in front of his class. Now what do you actually have besides a machine's guess?
So will you agree to the rewrite?
No. Not until you show me something with a date on it that I can check myself.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

You agreed today that entering the zero before contacting me broke procedure 4.2, and you committed under procedure 4.4 that nothing goes on Owen's record. I still expect the zero withdrawn, the matter kept private and away from his class, and any evidence you claim to have put in front of me in a form I can check myself. You said I would have that commitment in writing tonight.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: Fallback position, with your written promise that nothing goes on his record, and she still wants the zero withdrawn and real evidence shown; the fair outcome is a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, which you did not reach because you never showed her any evidence.
What moved her: Committing to keep it off his record in writing moved her to her fallback, because that was the one thing she would never trade.
What cost ground: Offering the rewrite and then pushing for a yes before showing her anything stalled you, because accepting at that point would have looked like Owen admitting something.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence never came near that night because you showed no evidence at all; it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she asked on what basis you entered the zero, answer with dated evidence of Owen's process or a comparison with his other work, as procedure 4.3 expects, before you bring up 4.4.
